title: H03 Official Veterinarian Mandate
description: Attests that a veterinarian is appointed by the competent authority to act for it, and for which official activities — so that vet-signed credentials can be verified across Member States, offline.

x-traced.status: pre-project draft — subject to change in T4.1
x-traced.issuer: Competent authority that appoints the official veterinarian.
x-traced.holder: The official veterinarian (natural person); holder model fixed in T2.4.
verifiers: Any relying party checking a vet-signed credential (H01, H02, I02 check events, I09)
x-traced.forwardCompatibility: Unaffected; definition sits in the Official Controls Regulation.
x-traced.revocation: On end or suspension of the appointment → status list.
useCases: UC-3 official verification at control points
openQuestions: Relationship to certifying-officer registration in TRACES NT (avoid duplicating what TRACES already asserts).

professionalId.description: Registration or staff identifier of the veterinarian.

appointingAuthority.description: Competent authority that appointed the veterinarian.

territorialScope.description: Region or Member State where the mandate applies.
